Non-linear 2-D embeddings of the 57 HELIX pregnancy exposures: a deep
autoencoder, t-SNE, UMAP and a variational autoencoder, coloured by cohort.

Source: `EnvBRAN/dim_red_aut.ipynb` (the `.md` export and its SVG figures
were dropped).

Ported from the implicit-parameter Flux API (`Flux.params`, `train!(loss, ps, data, opt)`)
to the explicit API of Flux ≥ 0.15 (`Flux.setup`, `train!(loss, model, data, state)`).

```{julia}
using ExposomicsJulia
using DataFrames, Statistics, LinearAlgebra, Plots
using Flux, UMAP, TSne
```

```{julia}
DT = load_helix_clean();
M_exp = Matrix{Float32}(rescale(Matrix{Float32}(DT[:, helix_exposure_names(DT)]); dims = 1));
X_all = permutedims(M_exp)                       # features × samples (Flux convention)
dl = Flux.DataLoader(X_all, batchsize = 100, shuffle = true)
cohort = string.(DT.h_cohort);
```

## Autoencoder

```{julia}
r = size(M_exp, 2)
model = Chain(Dense(r, 150, leakyrelu), Dense(150, 70, leakyrelu),
              Dense(70, 20, leakyrelu), Dense(20, 2, leakyrelu),     # encoder
              Dense(2, 20, leakyrelu), Dense(20, 70, leakyrelu),
              Dense(70, 150, leakyrelu), Dense(150, r))              # decoder

ae_loss(m, x) = Flux.Losses.mse(m(x), x)
ae_loss(model, X_all)
```

```{julia}
#| eval: false
opt_state = Flux.setup(Adam(), model)
for epoch in 1:1000
    Flux.train!(ae_loss, model, dl, opt_state)
end
ae_loss(model, X_all)
```

```{julia}
#| eval: false
model_encoder = model[1:4]
dt_red = model_encoder(X_all);
scatter_embedding(dt_red; groups = cohort, title = "Cluster Encoder")
```

## t-SNE and UMAP

```{julia}
#| eval: false
y_tsne = tsne(M_exp, 2, 57, 1000, 30, pca_init = true, progress = false);
scatter_embedding(y_tsne; groups = cohort, title = "Clusters T-Sne")
```

```{julia}
#| eval: false
umap_model = UMAP.fit(X_all, 2).embedding
scatter_embedding(umap_model; groups = cohort, title = "Clusters UMAP")
```

# Variational autoencoder

```{julia}
vae = (encoder = Chain(Dense(r, 20, leakyrelu), Parallel(tuple, Dense(20, 2), Dense(20, 2))),
       decoder = Chain(Dense(2, 20, leakyrelu), Dense(20, r)))

function reconstuct(m, x)
    μ, logσ = m.encoder(x)               # posterior parameters
    ϵ = randn(Float32, size(logσ))       # sample from N(0, I)
    z = μ + ϵ .* exp.(logσ)              # reparametrisation
    μ, logσ, m.decoder(z)
end

function vae_loss(m, x; λ = 0.005f0)
    len = size(x)[end]
    μ, logσ, decoder_z = reconstuct(m, x)
    # D_KL(q(z|x) || p(z|x))
    kl_q_p = 0.5f0 * sum(@. (exp(2f0 * logσ) + μ^2 - 1f0 - 2f0 * logσ)) / len
    # E[log p(x|z)]
    logp_x_z = -Flux.Losses.logitbinarycrossentropy(decoder_z, x, agg = sum) / len
    # L2 regularisation of the decoder weights
    reg = λ * sum(p -> sum(abs2, p), Flux.trainables(m.decoder))
    -logp_x_z + kl_q_p + reg
end

vae_loss(vae, X_all)
```

```{julia}
#| eval: false
opt_state = Flux.setup(Adam(0.001), vae)
for epoch in 1:50
    Flux.train!(vae_loss, vae, dl, opt_state)
end
vae_loss(vae, X_all)
```

```{julia}
#| eval: false
data_reduced = vae.encoder(X_all)    # (μ, logσ)
scatter_embedding(data_reduced[1]; groups = cohort, title = "Cluster Variational Encoder")
```
